scope: Reduced opposing top/bottom panel pair. Finite perimeter springs terminate on a reference frame, not a computed full cabinet. Brace beams use centroidal EI, no composite eccentric membrane action. Axial legs plus two glue layers. 10mm front member is actual P20D proposal; 22mm comparison conflicts with access and is only mechanical counterfactual. No strength, fatigue, complete front-hole, fastener or cabinet safety qualification. Material and joint parameters are scenarios, not measured properties.

controls.meaning: joint elastic compliance <=5% of axial leg compliance, not strength or whole-cabinet criterion

acceptance: Equilibrium/energy residual <1e-7. Mesh changes reported, not assumed <5%. No material strength threshold supplied.
